x-m-e4-04.s.s1.r.c: Kuziva kona ㄱ chete, unogona kusarudza zvimwe uchishandisa huwandu hwemakona matatu nechokwadi chekuti makona maviri akafanana.

x-m-e4-04.s.s1.explain: Kana kona ㄴ iri 50°, kona ㄷ inewo 50°. Kana kona ㄱ iri 80°, makona mamwe maviri anowedzera kusvika ku100° uye makona maviri akafanana, saka kona ㄷ ndi50°. Hurefu hwedivi ㄴㄷ kana shoko 'acute' oga hazvisarudzi kona ㄷ.

x-m-e4-04.s.s2.because.hint.1: Funga kuti chimwe chete chii chimwe chaungada kuziva kuti usarudze kona ㄷ.

x-m-e4-04.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Unogona kutsanangura kuti nei ruzivo rwekuti 'ndeye isosceles triangle' runobatsira here?

x-m-e4-05.title: Kufungidzira Zita re Quadrilateral Yakavanzika
x-m-e4-05.goal: Kana zvinoratidza zvichiwedzera, gadzirisa zita rechimiro nemazvo zvakanyanya, uye paradzanisa kuti mhinduro yako yekutanga yakanga isina kururama kana kuti yakangova isina kunyatsorurama.

x-m-e4-05.s.s1.prompt: Nguva imwe neimwe chinoratidza chichiratidzwa, sarudza zita raunogona kutaura izvozvi.

x-m-e4-05.s.s1.st.0.after: Kana pane mapeya maviri emativi anoenderana, ndeye parallelogram. Kana pane kunyangwe peya imwe chete yemativi anoenderana, ndeye trapezoid, saka trapezoid iri zvakare chinhu chakarurama kutaura, asi parallelogram inonyatsorurama zvakanyanya. Hatisati taziva kuti ndeye rhombus kana rectangle.
x-m-e4-05.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Mapeya maviri emativi anoenderana oga haakuudzi kuti mativi ane hurefu hwakafanana here.
x-m-e4-05.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Ndeye parallelogram. Inogona kuva rectangle kana rhombus
x-m-e4-05.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Izvi zvinotaurwa kuti zvienderane nezvinoreva mapeya maviri emativi anoenderana, uye zvinosiya zvisati zvazivikanwa.
x-m-e4-05.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Hapana chinoratidza chekuti makona ndeakarurama here.
x-m-e4-05.s.s1.st.1.info: Chinoratidza 2: Makona mana ose ane hukuru hwakafanana.
x-m-e4-05.s.s1.st.1.after: Makona mana ose akafanana uye anowedzera kusvika ku360°, saka rimwe nerimwe ndi90°. Parallelogram ine makona mana akarurama ndeye rectangle. Hatisati taziva hurefu hwemativi, saka hatigoni kutaura kuti ndeye square.
x-m-e4-05.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Ndeye rectangle. Kana makona mana akafanana, rimwe nerimwe ndi360°÷4=90°
x-m-e4-05.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Izvi zvakabatanidza huwandu hwemakona mana ne 'ose akafanana' kusvika kumakona akarurama.
x-m-e4-05.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Ndeye rhombus. Kana makona ose akafanana, mativi anofanirawo kuva akafanana
x-m-e4-05.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Makona kuva akafanana nemativi kuva akafanana zvinhu zvakasiyana.
x-m-e4-05.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Ndeye square. Nekuti makona ose akafanana
x-m-e4-05.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Hatisati taziva hurefu hwemativi, asi izvi zvakasarudza kuti ndeye square.
x-m-e4-05.s.s1.st.2.info: Chinoratidza 3: Mativi maviri ari padhuze ane hurefu hwakafanana.
x-m-e4-05.s.s1.st.2.ask: Zita rinonyatsorurama zvakanyanya nderipi, uye kutonga kwakarurama nezve 'parallelogram' yawakataura pakutanga kuri chii?

x-m-e4-05.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Ndeye rhombus. Kunyangwe ine makona akarurama, rhombus yakasiyana ne square
x-m-e4-05.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Kunyangwe ine makona akarurama inogona kuva rhombus, uye square ine mamiriro ose maviri. Tarisa kuti pane zita rinonyatsorurama zvakanyanya here.
x-m-e4-05.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Ndeye square. Square haisi parallelogram, saka mhinduro yekutanga yakanga isina kururama
x-m-e4-05.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Square inewo mapeya maviri emativi akatarisana anoenderana. Inosangana nemamiriro e parallelogram sezvazviri.
x-m-e4-05.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Ndeye square. Parallelogram yandakataura pakutanga yakanga isiri chinhu chisina kururama kutaurawo
x-m-e4-05.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Ndeye rectangle. Hurefu hwemativi hahudiwi kusarudza zita
x-m-e4-05.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Chinoratidza chekuti mativi ane hurefu hwakafanana chinodzikisa zita zvakanyanya.
x-m-e4-05.s.s1.reflect: Kana zvinoratidza zvichiwedzera, mhinduro yako yakachinja sei? Unoparadzanisa sei kana mhinduro yako yekutanga ichiva 'isina kururama' uye kana ichiva 'isina kunyatsorurama'?
